text:
Maya (Marketing): Quick sync — need final assets + copy for next week's launch push. Goal: LinkedIn carousel (6 slides) + X thread (6 tweets) + hero image for blog + 1 GIF demo for the tweet. Webinar reg: https://redwood.ai/webinar-register?utm_source=social&utm_campaign=launch_may
Jonas (Creative): Ok will start designs. 6 slides works. Any must-have data points or quotes?
Maya (Marketing): Include 2 benchmark visuals (latency vs cost), a one-line CTO quote, and a 3-bullet "How it works" slide. Keep copy minimal — big headers only.
Ava (Social): For X we'll do: hook -> problem -> stat -> demo gif -> CTA -> reg link. Need short headline options for A/B. I can draft tomorrow morning.
Ravi (Growth): Paid uplift? I can commit $1.2k for a 5-day LI boost if creatives ready. Need UTMs and recommended image specs.
Jonas (Creative): Uploading Figma now: https://www.figma.com/file/xxxx/redwood-launch-may . Exports will be 1200x1200 for slides and 1280x720 hero.
Maya (Marketing): Also need a 1:1 GIF (3–6s loop) showing KV cache animation for the demo tweet. Minimal captions inside the GIF.
Jonas (Creative): Can do GIF. ETA end-of-day Thursday for first pass.
Olivia (Ops): Scheduling windows: LinkedIn best Wed 9–11am PT; X best Thu 11am–1pm PT. Do we want LI then X or same-day?
Ava (Social): Prefer LI the day before X to seed the convo. Variant B should include a customer quote slide — who can confirm availability?
Maya (Marketing): I'll check with CS. @Olivia can you add the reg link + UTM template to the tracking doc and the scheduling notes? Use utm_campaign=launch_may
Olivia (Ops): Done: https://docs.google.com/spreads/track-launch-may — added UTM template and a scheduling checklist.
CS Bot: Routing created: new social leads from this campaign -> #inbound-launch and sales@redwood.ai
Ravi (Growth): For short links we'll use rdw.ai/launch-may for creatives. I'll hand off final tracking to analytics once assets are uploaded.
Ava (Social): Draft copy (short):
- Tweet A (control): "Latency that doesn't cost the earth. See how we cut per-token cost while keeping quality. [gif] Register → rdw.ai/launch-may"
- Tweet B (variant): "Ships faster. Cheaper. Safer. Join our webinar for tradeoffs & demos. [gif]"
Maya (Marketing): Make Tweet B the control for the paid boost; we'll A/B test against A organically. Track CTR and signups.
Jonas (Creative): Uploaded final exports to folder /marketing/assets/launch-may/ — files: li-slide1.png, li-slide2.png, li-slide3.png, li-slide4.png, li-slide5.png, li-slide6.png, hero-1280x720.jpg, kv-demo.gif
Ava (Social): Scheduling plan: LinkedIn carousel Wednesday 10:00am PT (6 slides + caption + alt text). X thread Thursday 11:30am PT. Paid boost start Thursday 12:00pm PT. I'll add alt text and tags.
Maya (Marketing): Olivia — pls confirm UTMs are attached in the scheduling notes before you hit publish.
Olivia (Ops): Confirmed. Checklist in scheduling tool includes: images uploaded, alt text, UTMs, landing URL, boost %, and tags.
Jonas (Creative): Legal check: can we claim "3x cheaper" on the benchmark slide? Need signoff. @Beth-Legal can you review.
Beth-Legal: Reviewing now. Suggest wording change: replace "3x cheaper" with "up to 3x lower per-token cost". I'll add the exact line edits in the doc.
Maya (Marketing): Thanks — we'll update slides and copy to Beth's wording. :thumbsup:
Ava (Social): I'll run pre-launch QA on Tuesday: check links, alt text, image crops on mobile, GIF playback, UTMs. Posting results here after QA.
Maya (Marketing): One last ask — Jonas, include filenames in the scheduling notes and confirm hero dimensions. Oliva — double-check LinkedIn carousel order matches the storyline.
Jonas (Creative): Filenames in scheduling notes now and hero is 1280x720. Carousel slides exported in numeric order.
Olivia (Ops): Done. Also scheduled a reminder for the growth team to enable the paid boost at 12pm PT Thu.
Maya (Marketing): Great work team. Once QA passes we'll close this thread and confirm the publish time in #marketing. :party_parrot:
